20th. JANUARY , 2011 No ． S 3 CUSTOMS ORDBR, 2 佣 6 39 / 06 , CUSTOMS (ASEAN TRADE IN GOOD S AGREEMENT) ORDER, 2010 89 / lo ,

NOTIFICATION OF COMMENC BMENT ln exercise of the power conferred by paragraph 1 , the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the lst, January , 2010 as the date on which the Customs (ASEAN Trade in Goods Agreement) Order, 2010 shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 14th · day of Safar, 1432 Hij riah corresponding to the 19th · day of January, 2011 · HAJI HISHAM BIN HAJI MOHD. HANIFAH P ermanent Secretary, Ministry of Financel Brunei Darussalam.
